_comment: Custom Pterodactyl egg for this uptime monitor app. Import via Admin > Nests > Import Egg.
name: Uptime Monitor
author: admin@example.com
description: Self-hosted uptime monitor (FastAPI + MySQL/MariaDB). Database connection, admin account, and all other settings are configured through the app itself on first boot at /setup - no egg variables besides the git repo/branch and port are needed.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
apt-get update && apt-get install -y git
cd /mnt/server
if [ -z "$(ls -A /mnt/server)" ]; then
  git clone "${GIT_REPOSITORY_URL}" --branch "${GIT_BRANCH}" .
fi
pip install -r requirements.txt --no-input
echo "Install complete. Start the server, then open the panel's Console tab and visit http://<allocation>/setup to finish setup (DB connection + admin account)."

variables.name: Git repository URL
variables.description: Repository to clone this app from on first install.
